tools.name: find_referencing_symbols
tools.title: Find referencing symbols
tools.description: Who calls this symbol, and what breaks if it changes? Lists the symbols that reference a target, by file and evidence tier: same-file, resolved-via-import, unique, name-only-ambiguous. Read the top two tiers as callers and the bottom two as candidates. The tier 'unique' means only that the repository defines the name one time. It does not mean that the two files are connected. A group marked 'locals not checked' comes from a language that has no scope analysis. Call it when the answer depends on the callers. It is the most expensive tool here: fan-in over a large repository can take minutes.

target.description: Stable id, qualified name or name.

repo_root.description: Absolute repository path. Omit it with one root; a refusal lists the roots.

limit.description: Maximum sites, one per file in turn. Default 50.

shared_callers.description: Rank symbols whose callers overlap the target's instead: the does-a-utility-already-exist check.

tools.name: history
tools.title: History
tools.description: Why does this code exist? The commits that changed one symbol's lines, newest first, with full message bodies. Call it after another tool tells you where.

target.description: Stable id from map, overview, find, explain or locate. A bare name is refused.

repo_root.description: Absolute repository path. Omit it with one root; a refusal lists the roots.

budget.description: Maximum tokens for commit bodies. Default 12000.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.title: Capabilities
tools.description: Why is this answer incomplete? The server version, grammars, cache state, roots and caps. Call it when a language seems unsupported or the wrong root was selected.

repo_root.description: Absolute repository path. Omit it with one root; a refusal lists the roots.

tools.name: orient
tools.title: Orient
tools.description: Rank the files and symbols most relevant to a focus, or show how the repository is built. map (focus, limit, granularity, budget): a token-budgeted map of the highest-ranked files. Call it when the location is unknown or the change spans files. Use grep for a known literal or file: the map ranks symbols, so a file that matches only by a string does not appear. budget counts chars/4: a real BPE count runs 10-35% higher. communities (resolution, limit): which files belong together. cycles (limit): module import cycles. diagram (focus, max_nodes, max_edges, group_by_communities, resolution): the module graph as mermaid, for a human. path (requires source and target; include_unique, include_ambiguous): the fewest-hop resolved chain between two endpoints. health (limit): orphan candidates, unused exports, hubs and complexity hotspots.

operation.description: The tool description says what each one takes.

repo_root.description: Absolute repository path. Omit it with one root; a refusal lists the roots.

focus.description: Paths, path suffixes, module stems or symbol names that seed the ranking. A traceback frame, blob URL or path:line seeds the file it names. diagram uses the first entry.

budget.description: Maximum tokens for the map. Omit it for automatic sizing in a 2000-8000 token band.

granularity.description: function lists symbols, file lists files alone, body adds budgeted bodies.

resolution.description: Larger values generally give smaller communities.

limit.description: Maximum rows: map files (default 10), communities, cycles, or rows per health section (default 20).

source.description: path: a stable id, qualified name or file path.

target.description: path: a stable id, qualified name or file path.

include_unique.description: path: allow unique-name edges, which are retrieval evidence, not binding evidence.

include_ambiguous.description: path: allow name-only edges, where several definitions share the spelling.

max_nodes.description: Nodes drawn before an elision node.

max_edges.description: Arrows drawn; the rest are counted.

no_cache.description: Parse every file live, bypassing the cache.

tools.name: symbols
tools.title: Symbols
tools.description: Look up a symbol and read it by symbol. find (requires name; kind, limit): symbols matching a name, Qualified.name or substring, with path:line and a stable id, then the files that use the name and do not declare it. overview (requires paths; docstrings): signatures with bodies elided; read it instead of the file. expand (requires stable_ids; limit): line-numbered bodies; expand a long id alone, because an over-budget batch is shortened. explain (requires target; limit): one symbol's definition, signature, fan-out and fan-in by evidence tier, and imports. locate (requires path and locations; context_lines): class:, function: and line: selectors as stable ids and line intervals. For callers and blast radius, use find_referencing_symbols.

operation.description: The tool description says what each one requires.

repo_root.description: Absolute repository path. Omit it with one root; a refusal lists the roots.

limit.description: Maximum rows: find and explain default 20, expand 10.

stable_ids.description: Stable ids from map, overview, find, explain or locate.

target.description: Stable id, qualified name or name. Ties list the others.

no_cache.description: Parse every file live, bypassing the cache.

tools.name: read
tools.title: Read
tools.description: You need file contents rather than symbols: numbered lines of one file with enclosing-scope headers (slice), or the repository tree with gitignore applied (dir). slice (requires path; lines or whole_file, not both; context_lines). dir (path, default the root; depth, max_entries). Prefer symbols operation 'expand' when a symbol boundary fits.

operation.description: The tool description says what each one takes.

repo_root.description: Absolute repository path. Omit it with one root; a refusal lists the roots.

path.description: Repository-relative path: the file for slice, the subtree for dir.

lines.description: One [start, end] range, or a list of them such as [[10, 40], [90, 120]]. 1-based and inclusive.

whole_file.description: The whole file, in place of lines.

depth.description: Directory levels below the tree root.

max_entries.description: Entries listed before the tree reports truncation.
